crossRefs.note: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still, and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.
Then the woman went to all the people in her wisdom. They cut off the head of Sheba the son of Bichri, and threw it out…
“Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the…
For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

translations.web: Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held the people back.
translations.bsb: Then Joab blew the ram’s horn, and the troops broke off their pursuit of Israel because Joab had restrained them.
translations.kjv: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel: for Joab held back the people.
translations.asv: And Joab blew the trumpet, and the people returned from pursuing after Israel; for Joab held back the people.
